cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus. REST v2 fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types. Symptoms: Returns wrong values for large integers, Array fields in raw protobuf format, AutoId not working for Int64 PK
cognition_match.note: This defect matches the known blindspot pattern: REST v2 API fails to validate JSON data type serialization. Maintenders have documented this as a repeated issue area.

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities+insert endpoint accepts and stores non-JSON plain strings in JSON-typed fields without validation, violating contract assertions milvus_type_json_001 and milvus_type_json_041. Source code analysis confirms missing validation: anyToColumns (utils.go:1967-1968) performs direct cast to []byte with no JSON validity check, and checkJSONFieldData (validate_util.go:980-1002) validates only byte length, not JSON format. This matches the documented blindspot pattern 'REST v2 API data type serialization'. Independent verification via query confirms stored value is plain string, not JSON. All three perspectives (contract violation, physical constraint violation, not by-design) confirm the defect.
